question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
WITH italian_dec_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        p.cust_id,
        SUM(p.amount_sold - p.TOTAL_COST) AS profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770
        AND t.calendar_year = 2021
        AND t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_id,
        profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY profit) AS tier
    FROM italian_dec_2021
)
SELECT 
    MIN(profit) AS lowest_profit,
    MAX(profit) AS highest_profit,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers
FROM ranked

    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id

)

    MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit_in_tier,

FROM ranked_customers
